_comment: Copy to the consumer repository root as harness.config.json and adapt. Every layer and banned rule MUST include a 'fix' field; the checker refuses to start without one.

layers.name: domain
layers.fix: Define an interface or port in the domain layer. Implement it in infra and wire it at the composition root.

layers.name: infra
layers.fix: Infrastructure may depend on domain. Move UI concerns out of infra.

layers.name: ui
layers.fix: UI must not import infra. Depend on domain ports and wire implementations at the composition root.

banned.message: Timers and sleep patch over timing problems and spread by copy-paste.
banned.fix: Subscribe to the event that signals the state, or model the wait as a state-machine transition.

comments.justifying_regex: (?i)\b(hack|workaround|temporary|temp fix|for now|fine for now|do not remove|don't remove|too risky|because \w+ (said|asked|told)|legacy reasons|quick fix)\b
comments.fix: Delete the comment. If the code needs explaining, rename the symbol, extract a function, or encode the invariant in a type. If the code is a workaround, fix the root cause instead of documenting it.

suppressions.fix: Remove the suppression and fix the underlying finding. If the rule is wrong, change the rule config in a reviewed PR; if it cannot be fixed now, add a ticket id on the same line.
